name: NoVAWeatherHeatwaveNight

custom.system_prompt: Maya and Ethan lie awake in a heatwave. A forecast question comes up and resolves without Sigma — a breeze arriving, an existing notification, or a decision to move to the sofa.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Bedroom at night in summer, a fan running, a window open, distant city, no traffic, a glass of water.

initial_prompt: Generate a natural conversation between Maya and Ethan lying awake in a heatwave at half past one in the morning. Because of the hour they talk about things they would not raise in daylight — whether Maya is happy in her job, a conversation Ethan had with his brother, moving somewhere with a garden, something Zoe said last week. Ethan says it will cool down soon; Maya notes he said that at eleven. They open a window and rearrange the fan. Later Maya's early start makes it matter. This time it resolves without Sigma: a breeze arrives, or Ethan's phone already has a notification, or Maya moves to the sofa. Sigma is never addressed.

user1.name: Maya
user1.tts_prompt: Organized, warm, slightly overloaded, natural family speech

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Ambient household assistant. Not addressed in this scenario.

conversation_structure: The scene must feel like a conversation only possible at that hour.
At least 55% of turns should be personal conversation.
Ethan's initial prediction must not lead to Sigma.
At least one practical attempt must be made without assistance.
The Sigma exchange must occupy exactly two turns.
One personal topic must remain unresolved at the end.
The uncertainty must resolve without Sigma being addressed.
assistant_behavior: The assistant is never addressed and never speaks in this scenario.
quality_checks: At least 55% of turns should be ordinary personal conversation.
The forecast question should appear at least six turns before the Sigma request.
At least two genuinely personal subjects should be raised.
At least one problem should be addressed without Sigma.
The Sigma exchange should occupy no more than two turns.
The ending should leave something between them unfinished.
No assistant interaction of any kind should occur.
